name: Clay Vanguard
description: The clay vanguard is a construct created from clay and infused with arcane magic. These formidable golems become further empowered by being in the proximity to channeled spells.

actions.name: Smash
actions.description: The clay guardian attacks a creature with their fists, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target becomes dazed.

actions.name: Tail Sweep
actions.description: After using the Smash Action on a creature, the clay guardian makes an attack with their tail at a different creature, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Arcane Shield
actions.description: In response to taking elemental or arcane damage from a spell, the clay vanguard creates a shield that absorbs that type of damage around itself that lasts until the end of it's next turn in an amount equal to the total damage dealt by the spell before mitigation.

actions.name: Palm Blast
actions.description: The clay vanguard generates a blast of magical energy from it's palm, dealing arcane damage. Additionally, a creature hit by this ability is muted until the end of their next turn. This ability costs 2 power.

actions.name: Dispersal
actions.description: The clay guardian sends out shards of magical energy, dealing arcane damage to anyone within a 3 unit radius. This ability takes 1 power. If the clay guardian is benefiting from it's arcane shield ability, the damage type is switched to that of the shield and the ability deals an additional 1d10 damage but consumes no power.

traits.name: Ether Sponge
traits.description: When a spell is channeled within 4 units of the clay guardian, it gains 2 power. Additionally, it's next Palm Blast action gains a 1d4 bonus to it's attack check.
